title: Empirical Bayes linear regression in high dimensions: Method of moments and sub-linear sample complexity
summary: We study empirical Bayes estimation of the prior in high-dimensional linear regression $\mathbf{y}=\mathbf{X}\mathbfβ+\mathbf{\varepsilon}$, where the regression coefficients are drawn independently from an unknown sub-Gaussian prior. In contrast to the sequence model, the design matrix couples the latent coefficients, so that recovering the prior requires deconvolving it from both the noise and copies of itself.
